question: What is the meaning of material family in relation to material information?
description: Material family refers to a group of materials that share similar properties or characteristics, which can be used to classify and organize material information. This classification helps in identifying and managing materials in a circular economy, ensuring efficient use and recycling of materials. Material family is an important aspect of material data collection and management, as it aids in the traceability and sustainability of materials throughout their life cycle.
